Treatment overview

What is a Pico Laser?

A pico laser fires pulses of light that last only a few hundred picoseconds, trillionths of a second. At that speed, the energy hits pigment or tattoo ink like a tiny shockwave and shatters it into dust-fine particles, instead of slowly heating it. Your body's natural clean-up system then clears those particles away over the following weeks.

Less heat means less irritation, fewer sessions and a lower chance of the skin darkening afterwards. That's why pico lasers have become the go-to choice for pigmentation and tattoo removal, especially on Indian skin.

Read more: picosecond vs nanosecond lasers

Older Q-switched lasers work in nanoseconds. Pico lasers are about a thousand times faster. In practice, that means:

  • Shatter, don't burn. Pigment breaks into much smaller particles that clear faster.
  • Less heat in the skin, so less redness and lower risk of post-laser darkening.
  • Fewer sessions for tattoos and stubborn pigment.
  • Collagen boost, which also improves pores and texture.

Read our guide to which pigmentation treatment works best.

1. Ultra-fast pulse450-picosecond light pulses reach the pigment or ink.
2. ShatterPigment breaks into dust-fine particles with little heat.
3. ClearYour body flushes the particles away over a few weeks.

PicoCare 450 is a true picosecond laser, firing an ultra-short 450-picosecond pulse at up to 1,300 megawatts of peak power. It aims precisely at pigment and ink while leaving the surrounding skin largely untouched, so treatments are faster, more comfortable and need less recovery than with older lasers.

Melasma shows up as brown patches on the cheeks, forehead or upper lip, often triggered by hormones and sun. Strong heat can make it worse, which is why pico toning works so well: it breaks pigment with very short pulses and very little heat.

Your appointment

Pico Laser Procedure: Step by Step

Your consultation decides the right mode and settings for your skin.

  • Your doctor examines your skin and pigment, and reviews your medical history.
  • Stay out of strong sun for 2 weeks before. Tanned skin raises the risk of complications.
  • Stop scrubs, retinoids and bleaching creams 3 days before.
  • Tell us about any new medicines, as some make skin light-sensitive.
  • Come with clean skin, without makeup.

Most sessions take 20 to 30 minutes.

  • Your skin is cleansed. Numbing cream is applied for spot or tattoo work.
  • You wear protective eye shields throughout.
  • The doctor passes the PicoCare handpiece over the area.
  • Toning feels like light, warm snaps. Spot and tattoo work is a little stronger.
  • A cooling gel, moisturiser and SPF 50 are applied at the end.

Most people go straight back to their day. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Mild redness for a few hours after toning.
  • Treated spots darken and form tiny crusts that flake off in 5 to 7 days.
  • Tattoos may look white or swollen for a short time, then heal over a week.
  • Apply moisturiser and SPF 50+ every day.
  • Avoid retinol, exfoliants and other skin treatments for 5 days.

Recovery & results

Pico Laser Results Timeline

Pico laser clears pigment in stages as your body flushes the shattered particles away.

  1. Right after

    Fresh & bright

    Skin looks brighter after toning. Spots may look a little darker.

  2. Day 3–7

    Spots flake off

    Treated spots crust and flake, revealing clearer skin.

  3. Weeks 2–4

    Pigment fades

    Marks and patches keep lightening as your body clears the particles.

  4. After a course

    Even, clear skin

    Pigmentation is much lighter and tone more even. Sunscreen keeps it that way.

A good fit if you

  • Have melasma, acne marks or dark patches
  • Have freckles or sun spots
  • Want a tattoo removed or faded
  • Want brighter skin with no downtime

Wait if you have

  • A fresh tan or sunburn
  • Active infection or cold sores on the area
  • Been on isotretinoin recently
  • Pregnancy (we usually postpone)

Aftercare

Pico Laser Aftercare

Sun protection is the most important part of protecting your results.

Do

  • Use a gentle cleanser and cool water
  • Moisturise 2 to 3 times a day
  • Apply SPF 50+ and reapply outdoors
  • Use a cool compress if skin feels warm

Avoid

  • Hot baths, saunas and steam
  • Intense workouts
  • Makeup on crusted spots
  • Scratching or picking

Do

  • Let crusts fall off on their own
  • Keep moisturising
  • Wear a hat or carry an umbrella outdoors
  • Use SPF every single day

Avoid

  • Retinol and exfoliants for 5 days
  • Other skin treatments for a week
  • Direct midday sun
  • Swimming until crusts heal

Morning

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Brightening serum if your doctor approves
  • Moisturiser
  • SPF 50, reapplied every 2 to 3 hours outdoors

Night

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Prescribed depigmenting cream (for melasma)
  • Moisturiser
  • Keep up your session schedule

Your skin type

Pico Laser for Every Skin Type

Indian and darker skin tones
Pico laser is one of the safest laser options for darker skin because it uses so little heat. We start with conservative settings and build up, and ask for strict sun protection.
Melasma-prone skin
Pico toning is gentle enough for melasma when done at the right settings and spacing. Combining it with home creams and sunscreen gives the best control.
Sensitive skin
Toning is usually well tolerated. We avoid treating over irritated skin and may calm it first.
Oily, acne-prone skin
Great for acne marks once breakouts are under control. Pico toning can also help with oiliness and pores.
Recently tanned skin
We wait for a fresh tan to settle (2 to 4 weeks) before laser, to reduce the risk of pigmentation.

Safety first

Pico Laser Side Effects and Who Should Wait

Pico laser is well tolerated. Here's what's normal and when to check with your doctor first.

Common and temporary

  • Mild redness and warmth for a few hours
  • Treated spots darkening before they flake off
  • Small crusts for 5 to 7 days after spot work
  • Swelling or pinpoint bleeding after tattoo removal
  • Temporary lightening or darkening of skin (uncommon)

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have a fresh tan or sunburn
  • Have taken isotretinoin in the last 6 months
  • Use light-sensitive medicines
  • Have active infection, cold sores or a history of keloids

Questions

Pico Laser FAQs

What makes a pico laser different from a regular laser?
Older (Q-switched) lasers fire in nanoseconds and mostly heat pigment. A pico laser fires in picoseconds, a thousand times faster, so it shatters pigment with a pressure wave and much less heat. That means better results, fewer sessions and less risk of darkening, which matters a lot for Indian skin.
What is PicoCare 450?
PicoCare 450 is an advanced picosecond Nd:YAG laser with an ultra-short 450-picosecond pulse and very high peak power. It treats pigmentation, melasma, freckles, tattoos and skin rejuvenation with precision and minimal downtime.
Is PicoCare 450 available elsewhere in Trivandrum?
Facelit is the only clinic in Trivandrum offering PicoCare 450, so you can get true picosecond treatment without travelling to another city.
Does pico laser hurt?
Pico toning feels like light, warm snaps on the skin and most people don't need numbing. Spot and tattoo treatments are stronger, so we apply numbing cream first.
How many sessions will I need?
It depends on the concern. Freckles may clear in 1 to 3 sessions, acne marks in 4 to 6, and melasma usually needs 6 to 10 toning sessions. Tattoos take 4 to 10 depending on the ink.
Is there any downtime?
Pico toning has no downtime. Spot treatment leaves small dark crusts that flake off in 5 to 7 days. Tattoo removal needs about a week of healing.
Is pico laser safe for Indian skin?
Yes. Because it uses far less heat than older lasers, the risk of post-laser darkening is lower. We still adjust settings carefully and ask you to use sunscreen every day.
Can pico laser cure melasma permanently?
Melasma can't be cured permanently, as hormones and sun can trigger it again. Pico toning can lighten it a lot, and a good home routine and sunscreen keep it under control.
When will I see results?
Skin often looks brighter after the first toning session. Spots fade within 1 to 2 weeks of a spot treatment, while melasma and tattoos improve gradually over a course.
Can pico laser remove all tattoo colours?
It works best on black and dark blue. Red and some other colours also respond well. Green and light blue can be more stubborn. We'll assess your tattoo at the consultation.
Can I combine pico laser with other treatments?
Yes. It pairs well with chemical peels, HydraFacial and microneedling. Your doctor will space them safely.
Where can I get pico laser treatment in Kerala?
PicoCare 450 is available at Facelit in Trivandrum (Kowdiar). Our team can also guide patients from Karunagappally and Guruvayur.
How much does pico laser treatment cost?
Cost depends on the area, the concern and the number of sessions. Tattoo removal is priced by size. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
